title: WaterColor "YOLO" 800 Western Lake
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Located in the Park District of WaterColor- Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes- Conveniently located near Publix & restaurants- New Thermidor and Subzero appliances- Gas grill on the newly screened in porch- 3 adult bikes- Spacious Porches- High-Speed Wireless Internet - Additional cable package HBO and Sports package- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout. Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Seize the opportunity for a fabulous 30A getaway at YOLO, a charming 3-bedroom, 4-bathroom home that comfortably accommodates 10 guests. Located in the WaterColor Park district, this 2-level property offers access to all of WaterColor’s amenities and a convenient location near Seaside. Stroll along the footpaths through acres of gardens and parks, soak up sun rays on the pristine sugar sand beaches, or take advantage of the world-famous WaterColor Beach Club—only a 10-minute walk away. Guests looking for a leisurely retreat will love unwinding on the numerous porches with a cool drink in the fresh breeze.A beautiful covered front porch with cushioned wicker seating and overhead fans welcomes guests upon arrival. Inside, discover a lovely primary bedroom and a well-appointed guest bedroom, each featuring a king bed, private bathroom, and porch access. Kids and young-at-heart guests will enjoy spending cheerful evenings in the bunk room, boasting 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds, or the bunk nook, with 1 twin-over-twin bed. Each bunk features a reading light and a USB port for convenience.A dazzling Capiz shell chandelier and classic wainscoted walls create a warm, coastal atmosphere as guests ascend to the second-level great room. Relax on 2 slip-covered sofas and armchairs in the living space, filled with natural light from the French doors and transom windows. A Smart TV and surround sound are the ultimate additions for effortless entertainment. Steps away, an expansive table for 8 invites delicious dinners and lively card games. The spacious chef’s kitchen features Thermador and Sub-Zero appliances and a vast center island perfect for prepping veggies or arranging snacks, with a 4-stool breakfast bar on the end. On the first screened-in porch, find a gas grill and an extended picnic table, surrounded by idyllic nature views. The second porch features rocking and Adirondack chairs for tranquil relaxation. A queen sleeper sofa in the living space provides additional sleeping accommodations.YOLO offers stunning outdoor spaces and WaterColor’s resort-style amenities for an unforgettable 30A vacation. Easily explore with parking for 2 vehicles or cruise the neighborhood on the 3 complimentary adult bikes. For beach access, choose between the WaterColor Beach Club or the access located on Goldenrod Circle past the WaterColor Inn. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo- Bunk Room: Two sets of Twin over Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo- Bunk Nook: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/ Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR- Living Room: Queen Sleeper SofaWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
